description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and classes related to a Document Store system, including data structures for document metadata, file chunks, loaders, and operations for managing document storage and retrieval.

classes.name: DocumentStoreDTO
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for DocumentStore entity, including methods to convert from entity and to entity.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename(s) from a base64 string or JSON array.

methods.name: addLoaderSource
methods.description: Generates a source description string for a document loader based on its configuration.

methods.name: DocumentStoreDTO.fromEntity
methods.description: Creates a DocumentStoreDTO instance from a DocumentStore entity, parsing JSON fields and setting source info.

methods.name: DocumentStoreDTO.fromEntities
methods.description: Creates an array of DocumentStoreDTO instances from an array of DocumentStore entities.

methods.name: DocumentStoreDTO.toEntity
methods.description: Converts a plain object into a DocumentStore entity, setting default status and stringifying certain fields.
